ev.q: uses a physics integrated engine and cooking mechanics to simulate a realistic cooking experience
There are various game modes including Career Mode, Sandbox Mode
the player to prepare over 80 recipes using more than 140 ingredients
The goal is to reach the fifth Fame Star
set after a nuclear holocaust in the 1980s
the player must ration and prepare food for their bunker
difficult controls, repetitiveness, lack of difficulty levels
were fun in short sessions and frustrating in the long
